conf.description: BlueCat DDI dns-query / syslog-raw: hand-built regex pipeline over the ISC BIND named querylog line grammar (no Elastic integration, no Cribl pack exists), per recommendations.direct.cribl -- splits the shared BIND channel on category so only 'queries' lines reach this dataset, gives rpz rewrites their own branch, defaults network.transport=udp when the T flag is absent, and expands the +/-, D and C flag characters into the dns.header_flags token array.

conf.comment: bluecat / dns-query / syslog-raw. BIND querylog forwarded by BDDS syslog redirection. Splits the shared queries/query-errors/security/lame-servers/rpz/update/xfer-out channel down to 'queries' category only per recommendations.direct.cribl; rpz rewrites (same category, different verb) get their own branch. Direct route, no guard hop.

functions.description: record dataset, format, and the channel-split approach
split the syslog header (BSD-style) from the BIND message body, and pull category/severity
keep only the 'queries' logging category in this dataset; query-errors/security/lame-servers/update/xfer-out belong to other datasets
parse the plain 'query:' verb line: client handle, client ip#port, view, QNAME/CLASS/TYPE/flags, destination ip
parse the 'rpz' verb line (Response Policy Zone rewrite), same channel as plain queries
decompose the BIND flag token (+/-, T, S, E(n), D, C) into its component characters
batch-rename every clean (space/hyphen-free) mapped field to its ECS target
derive ECS fields that need transforms (QNAME cleanup, transport default, header-flags array, rpz action) and set BlueCat-specific customs
parse the BSD syslog timestamp into Cribl's canonical _time (Elastic destination maps this to @timestamp)
